claims: The Texas House of Representatives is the lower chamber of the Texas Legislature.
The Texas House of Representatives is comprised of 150 members.
Members of the Texas House of Representatives are elected from single-member districts.
Members of the Texas House of Representatives are elected for two-year terms.
As of 2025, Republicans hold 88 seats in the Texas House of Representatives.
The Texas House of Representatives convenes at the Texas Capitol in Austin.
As of 2026, the Texas House of Representatives is led by Speaker Dustin Burrows.
The Texas House of Representatives has no term limits.
Dustin Burrows has been serving as Speaker of the Texas House of Representatives since 2025.
The Texas House of Representatives is located at the Texas State Capitol in Austin.
As of 2025, the Texas House of Representatives has 88 Republicans and 62 Democrats.
The Texas House passes legislation.
The Texas House sets the state budget.
The Texas House initiates articles of impeachment.
A member of the Texas House must be a citizen of the United States.
A member of the Texas House must be a qualified elector of the State of Texas.
A member of the Texas House must be at least 21 years old.
A member of the Texas House must have lived in Texas for at least two years.
A member of the Texas House must have lived in the district they are representing for the last year.
Regular sessions of the Texas House convene on the second Tuesday of January in odd-numbered years.
The Governor can call special sessions of the Texas House.
